title: Lumen service ownership
text: Iris owns Lumen. Lumen depends on River.

title: River data pipeline
text: River uses Maple. Leon maintains Maple.

title: Maple storage contract
text: Maple stores invoices. Maple replicates to Birch.

title: Birch recovery ownership
text: Nia owns Birch. Birch stores backups.

title: Harbor billing workflow
text: Oren owns Harbor. Harbor depends on River.

title: Cedar monitoring
text: Cedar monitors Lumen. Cedar monitors Harbor.

title: Meadow analytics
text: Uma owns Meadow. Meadow reads Birch.

title: Quartz exports
text: Quartz exports invoices. Kai maintains Quartz.

title: Unresolved Harbor ownership memo
text: Sana owns Harbor. This memo conflicts with the Harbor billing workflow.

title: Restricted routes
text: River never writes to Quartz. Lumen may use Quartz after a future migration.

title: Storm archival service
text: Zoe owns Storm. Storm archives receipts.

title: Summit receipt processor
text: Summit consumes receipts. Summit depends on Storm.
